text:
Predicates:
ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
American(x) ::: x is an American national.
CanDoJumpShot(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
LeapsIntoAir(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
ActivateLegMuscles(x) ::: x activates his leg muscles.
Yuri ::: the individual named Yuri.

Premises:
∃x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬American(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(x) → CanDoJumpShot(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (CanDoJumpShot(x) → LeapsIntoAir(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, then they leap straight into the air.
∀x (LeapsIntoAir(x) → ActivateLegMuscles(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, then they activate their leg muscles.
¬ActivateLegMuscles(Yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.

Conclusion:
¬(ProfessionalBasketballPlayer(Yuri) ∧ American(Yuri)) ::: Yuri is not both a professional basketball player and an American.
